import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][] pos = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] tMat = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] aMat = new int[150][150];

    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap;
        FlowEdge(int t, int r, long c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            cap = c;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int n, s, t;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<FlowEdge>> adj;
        int[] dist, ptr;

        MaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            dist = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long c) {
            adj.get(u).add(new FlowEdge(v, adj.get(v).size(), c));
            adj.get(v).add(new FlowEdge(u, adj.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (FlowEdge e : adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] == -1) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long f) {
            if (u == t) return f;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                FlowEdge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] == dist[u] + 1) {
                    long ret = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (ret > 0) {
                        e.cap -= ret;
                        adj.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                        return ret;
                    }
                }
                ptr[u]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxflow() {
            long ans = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                long f;
                while ((f = dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) ans += f;
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static void fillT(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int cur) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n) return;
        char c = sc[i].charAt(j);
        if (!Character.isDigit(c) && c != 'Z') return;
        if (tMat[i][j] != -1 && tMat[i][j] <= cur) return;
        tMat[i][j] = (tMat[i][j] == -1) ? cur : Math.min(tMat[i][j], cur);
        fillT(i + 1, j, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillT(i - 1, j, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillT(i, j + 1, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillT(i, j - 1, sc, n, cur + 1);
    }

    static void fillA(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int cur) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n) return;
        if (!Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) return;
        if (aMat[i][j] != -1 && aMat[i][j] <= cur) return;
        aMat[i][j] = (aMat[i][j] == -1) ? cur : Math.min(aMat[i][j], cur);
        fillA(i + 1, j, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillA(i - 1, j, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillA(i, j + 1, sc, n, cur + 1);
        fillA(i, j - 1, sc, n, cur + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        int n2 = n * n;
        int total = n2 * 2 + 2;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(total, 0, total - 1);
        String[] grid = new String[n];
        String[] caps = new String[n];
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt++;
            }
        }
        int zi = 0, zj = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zi = i;
                    zj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            caps[i] = sc.next();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(tMat[i], -1);
        fillT(zi, zj, grid, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (tMat[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(grid[i].charAt(j))) {
                    tMat[i][j] = t;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int lim = grid[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    mf.addEdge(0, pos[i][j], lim);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) Arrays.fill(aMat[k], -1);
                    fillA(i, j, grid, n, 0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (aMat[k][l] != -1 && tMat[k][l] != -1 && aMat[k][l] <= tMat[k][l] && aMat[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean ok = true;
                                if (aMat[k][l] == tMat[k][l]) {
                                    ok = false;
                                    if (k + 1 < n && aMat[k + 1][l] != -1 && aMat[k + 1][l] < tMat[k + 1][l]) ok = true;
                                    if (k - 1 >= 0 && aMat[k - 1][l] != -1 && aMat[k - 1][l] < tMat[k - 1][l]) ok = true;
                                    if (l + 1 < n && aMat[k][l + 1] != -1 && aMat[k][l + 1] < tMat[k][l + 1]) ok = true;
                                    if (l - 1 >= 0 && aMat[k][l - 1] != -1 && aMat[k][l - 1] < tMat[k][l - 1]) ok = true;
                                }
                                if (ok) mf.addEdge(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lim);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps[i].charAt(j))) {
                    mf.addEdge(n2 + pos[i][j], total - 1, caps[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mf.maxflow());
    }
}
